sources.quote: Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).
BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL and lists only Alluminio B as approved. Meccanica C has no approval for this part, plant and customer, so it cannot be added as an alternate source without a new approval.

sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
Fastener holes: 4 x diameter 8.5 mm H12, edges deburred, no cracks or tears visible at 10x magnification.

findings.why: Meccanica C has an open 8D on cracks at fastener holes in 6xxx-alloy (6061-T6) brackets. BR-220 is a 6xxx-alloy part with 4 fastener holes, and the quote is for 6061-T6 billet. The email confirms the 8D is still open.

sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: Drawing Rev C (released, effective) requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). Meccanica C offers EN AW-6061-T6. The email's claim of 6061-T6 with a 240 MPa minimum does not match the drawing in force. A 240 MPa minimum is below the 250 MPa required, and equivalence to 6082 is only asserted by the supplier.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.

findings.why: The only support for 6061-T6 meeting the strength requirement is the supplier's verbal claim of equivalence. No material certificate or test result for the offered 6061-T6 billet is in the documents. Someone must provide Rp0.2 evidence against SC-01.
